posts.author: CHAC3MEN
posts.text: Last concall the promoter mentioned the upcoming concalls will be half yearly. Recent upmove in the price is probably related to the high h1n1 cases reported throughout the country. Also now that a comparable peer is listed (molbio) the price discovery is happening. One more thing to note is that the promoter mentioned they should have something (M&A) by end of this year, so the market is probably anticipating some news.

posts.author: CHAC3MEN
posts.text: Molbio Diagnostics IPO coming up at PE 56, PS 6.4. 3BBb current valuation is PE 17.7, PS 7.3 and honestly better on most other ratios too. Big difference is TAM — Molbio’s is way bigger (multifold). Unless 3B BlackBio grows its TAM, don’t see much re-rating happening for them. Their move to sample-to-answer is a step in the right direction.
